g.text: Does chemical allocation matter at a common initial amount?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Local chemistry and both species totals matched once at t=510. Amounts then evolve freely on shared frozen physics.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: * Above the prespecified screen E>0.01. All matching references, physical contexts and doses shown.

g.text: Three existing histories; six recipients are nested measurements. All scientific decisions must agree across five solvers/timesteps.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Delayed challenges use actual unpulsed endpoints without rematching. This isolates an initial budget intervention, not continuously fixed dosage.

g.text: Delayed phase remains provisional: one near-stationary control fails its order gate at ~1.6e-13. No autonomous identity claim.
